tweet.text: Some Legacy Media is reporting tonight that my role has changed. This is total nonsense. I expect to spend 50% of my time in D.C. guiding policy and 50% in Silicon Valley staying on the cutting edge. This seems ideal for a tech policy role — and it’s exactly what I requested.
